_comment: Fixed upstream commits for the seven KGFM repositories. Clones are pinned by detached checkout at these SHAs; no branch is ever tracked. Reproduce with scripts/clone_repos.sh. repos/ itself is gitignored -- this file is the record.

motif.note: ULTRA fork; adds higher-order motif relation graph + Triton rspmm.

trix.note: ULTRA fork; split entity/relation runners, recursive relation update.

flock.note: ULTRA/TRIX/MOTIF-derived; random-walk 'petals' via graph-walker C++ ext.

semma.note: ULTRA fork; adds LLM/text semantic relation graph alongside structural one.

kg-icl.note: NOT an ULTRA fork. Prompt-graph in-context learner, own rspmm variant.

kgpfn.commit_subject: Support model configs and tail-only evaluation
kgpfn.note: NOT an ULTRA fork. Prior-fitted-network; vendors ULTRA only as a baseline.

incite.commit_subject: INCITE image v1: TRIX stack + patched trix tree + incite package
incite.note: Our own model, wraps no upstream repo. 'commit' is a manually bumped version string; the image tag is its first 8 chars (kgfm/incite:incite01). Bump rule in containers/incite/Dockerfile header. Never alias another model's pin.
